about.title: About Us | Consciencia Creativa

hero.subtitle: Consciencia Creativa integrates conscious wellbeing, human leadership, emotional intelligence and organizational evolution to build more human ways of living, working and leading.

purpose.body1: We live in a fast-paced, hyperproductive and emotionally exhausting world — one where many people feel constant pressure to perform, advance and manage multiple responsibilities at once.
purpose.body2: Consciencia Creativa is born as an invitation to evolve in a different way. More conscious. More human. More sustainable.
purpose.body3: We believe it is possible to grow professionally without disconnecting emotionally. That it is possible to lead from humanity. And that wellbeing shouldn't be a reward at the end of the road — it should be part of the journey itself.

about.mission_body: To accompany people and organizations in evolving with more clarity, humanity and balance, integrating emotional wellbeing, conscious leadership and sustainable professional growth.
about.vision_body: To build an ecosystem where wellbeing, technology, human transformation and innovation coexist harmoniously, creating new ways of living, working and leading in today's world.

values.v1_body: We don't believe in growth based solely on pressure or constant demand. We believe that when a person understands themselves better, they lead better, work better and live better.
values.v2_body: We integrate human sensitivity, emotional depth and emotional intelligence into every process. Wellbeing isn't a luxury — it's part of the path to real success.
values.v3_body: We accompany real processes of change: reconnecting with oneself, developing emotional tools, strengthening wellbeing and evolving from authenticity.

method.subtitle: A four-step process designed so that transformation is deep, real and sustainable — not just on paper, but in daily life and work.
method.s1_body: We listen, analyze data and understand the real state of the organization before proposing any solution.
method.s2_body: We design solutions together with your team, not for your team. This ensures genuine adoption and real commitment.
method.s3_body: We accompany the rollout in daily operations, managing resistance to change and adjusting in real time.
method.s4_body: We monitor results and deliver a documented process so the organization can operate autonomously.

team.m1_bio: Software engineer with over 10 years of experience in technology development for companies across multiple sectors. He leads the digital architecture of Consciencia Creativa, integrating automation tools, business intelligence and data analytics to turn consulting into measurable, scalable solutions.
team.m2_bio: With over 15 years turning human talent into the real engine of business, Ana Isabel leads the design and implementation of organizational development strategies. A specialist in executive coaching, diversity & inclusion and change management, she is an active member of the international HR Directors organization (DCH) and certified in Behavioral Sciences by Universidad EIA.

andanas.h2: A vision built between humanity and technology
andanas.body: Consciencia Creativa is part of Andanas Group, a human, creative and technological ecosystem developed by Ana Isabel Ramírez and Andrés Rubiano del Chiaro with a profound idea: to create solutions, experiences and spaces that integrate human consciousness, wellbeing, innovation and technology in a more authentic, strategic and sustainable way.
andanas.col1_body: Human transformation · Conscious wellbeing · Leadership · Organizational culture · Emotional intelligence · Personal and professional evolution
andanas.col2_body: Technology vision · Systems thinking · Innovation · Digital strategy · Solution architecture · Automation · Digital transformation

planeacion.title: Smart Planning: OKRs and KPIs | Consciencia Creativa

hero.subtitle: We align your board's objectives with your teams' day-to-day through the design and implementation of OKR and KPI systems with a human focus.

problems.h2: Why do traditional planning processes fail?
problems.p1_body: Leadership has a clear goal, but operational teams move in different directions without knowing how their daily tasks impact the business.
problems.p2_body: An overload of metrics that measure "effort" or "hours" but don't reflect real results in profitability, efficiency or market growth.
problems.p3_body: Forcibly copying Google's OKR model creates frustration, team resistance and organizational analysis paralysis.

proposal.h2: Metric + Human Fusion: OKRs that teams actually adopt
proposal.body1: We're not just software or spreadsheet consultants. At Consciencia Creativa we understand that behind every indicator (KPI) or key result (OKR) are people who need motivation, clarity and mental health to achieve them.
proposal.body2: We combine analytical data rigor with effective communication dynamics to eradicate institutional resistance to change.
proposal.stat1_body: Goal achievement success rate compared to static annual planning.
proposal.stat2_body: Alignment of department heads under an agile quarterly rhythm.
proposal.box_h4: How do we directly impact your business?
proposal.kpi_body: Define the health and stability of your daily operations. They tell you what's working today and where performance gaps exist.
proposal.okr_body: Drive transformation and innovation. They focus 100% of business energy toward the quarter's disruptive goal.
proposal.ritmo_body: We design short weekly review ceremonies so that objectives don't die in a forgotten file.

stages.subtitle: We ensure a smooth, high-commitment transition for your company.
stages.s1_body: We analyze the current state of your metrics, accountability culture and management bottlenecks.
stages.s2_body: Working sessions with the C-Level team to draft annual and institutional Objectives, cascading them to each area.
stages.s3_body: Theoretical and practical training for middle managers and staff, reducing fear of "control" and turning it into autonomy.
stages.s4_body: We institutionalize weekly check-ins and quarterly reviews (CFRs) to pivot quickly based on the market.

faq.q1: Do you work with startups or only large companies?
faq.a1: We work with organizations of all sizes: from startups with 10 people to corporations with more than 500 employees. Size doesn't determine the value of the intervention — the leaders' openness to change does.
faq.q2: What cities and countries do you operate in?
faq.a2: Our main base is Colombia, operating in Bogotá, Medellín and Cali. However, we serve clients across Latin America virtually. In-person workshops are available in Colombian cities and with agreed travel to other countries.
faq.q3: Are the workshops in-person or virtual?
faq.a3: We offer both formats. In-person workshops have greater impact for team dynamics and DISC sessions. Strategic planning consultancies and individual mentoring work perfectly in virtual format. We co-design the format based on your needs.
faq.q4: How long does a typical project last?
faq.a4: It depends on scope. A DISC workshop session can be done in a single day. A complete OKR strategic planning process takes 4 to 8 weeks. A pay equity analysis typically requires 3 to 6 weeks. We always define timelines and deliverables before starting.

hero.h1_sub: in the right role, from day one.
hero.subtitle: We recruit based on competencies, culture and growth potential. We don't just fill vacancies — we build the team your company needs for the next stage.

cost.eyebrow: The cost of a bad hire
cost.h2: A bad hire costs between 3 and 6 times the annual salary of the position
cost.c1_body: Technically brilliant candidates who don't adapt to the organizational culture, generating team conflicts and departures within the first 90 days.
cost.c2_body: Vague job postings that attract volume but not quality, overwhelming the HR team with irrelevant resumes and extending hiring time.
cost.c3_body: The investment in hiring is lost if the candidate's first month isn't structured to ensure their adaptation and success in the role.

approach.body1: We integrate the DISC methodology and competency-based interviews to evaluate not just what the candidate knows, but how they act under pressure, how they communicate with their team and how they face role challenges.
approach.body2: The final result is a documented shortlist with a comparative report that allows management to make an informed, technically supported decision.
approach.stat1_body: Reduction in early turnover (first 6 months) with our process.
approach.stat2_body: Faster time to fill key vacancies compared to traditional internal processes.
approach.p1_body: We define the behavioral DNA and soft skills required for success, beyond technical responsibilities.
approach.p2_body: We map the behavioral profile of finalists and cross-reference it with the existing team's dynamics.
approach.p3_body: STAR methodology to evaluate with concrete evidence, eliminating decisions based solely on subjective impressions.

stages.subtitle: From profile definition to negotiation and onboarding.
stages.s1_body: Working session with the role's leader to define technical, soft skills and cultural fit of the ideal candidate.
stages.s2_body: Strategic posting, active LinkedIn search and pre-selection based on previously defined objective criteria.
stages.s3_body: DISC and reasoning tests for finalist candidates, with a team compatibility report.
stages.s4_body: Presentation of the top 3 candidates with a comparative report and support during salary negotiation and onboarding.

hero.subtitle: We design competitive and equitable salary structures based on market data, eliminating the gaps that generate frustration and turnover in your team.

hidden_cost.h2: Why is your company losing talent without understanding why?
hidden_cost.c1_body: New hires earn the same or more than experienced employees, generating silent resentment and unexpected departures of key talent.
hidden_cost.c2_body: Without a clear salary band structure, negotiations become arbitrary, generating mistrust and perceptions of favoritism in the organization.
hidden_cost.c3_body: Salary scales don't keep pace with the market, causing the company to lose high-potential candidates to local and international competitors.

proposal.h2: Internal equity + external competitiveness: the formula for retaining talent
proposal.body1: We combine role valuation methodologies with real market benchmarking to create a salary structure that feels fair internally and attractive to the candidates you want to hire.
proposal.body2: The result: less turnover, clearer performance conversations and an employee value proposition aligned with their growth ambitions.
proposal.stat1_body: Reduction in voluntary turnover in the first year post-implementation.
proposal.stat2_body: Benchmarking with real market data from your sector and industry.
proposal.c1_body: Points and levels methodology to objectively classify each position by impact, complexity and autonomy.
proposal.c2_body: Comparison of your scales with market salary surveys for your sector, region and company size.
proposal.c3_body: Design of minimum-mid-maximum ranges that allow growth within the role and link salary to performance.

process.subtitle: Four stages for objective and sustainable compensation.
process.s1_body: Survey and documentation of all profiles and their actual responsibilities, distinguishing between the role and the person filling it.
process.s2_body: Objective classification of each role using criteria of organizational impact, technical complexity and autonomy.
process.s3_body: Cross-reference of your current scales with market data for your sector, city and company size to identify critical gaps.
process.s4_body: Delivery of the final structure with a gradual implementation plan, without traumatic fiscal impact for the company.
